source_anchor.quote: The lamp shall emit at least 400 lm within 2.0 s of switch-on.

requirements.text: The lamp shall emit at least 400 lm within 2.0 s of switch-on.

testability_flags.reason: Light output depends on supply voltage and ambient temperature, and neither is stated.
testability_flags.suggested_rewrite: The lamp shall emit at least 400 lm within 2.0 s of switch-on at [supply voltage in V] and [ambient temperature in °C].

preconditions: Lamp at room temperature and switched off for at least [soak time in min]
setup: Mount the lamp in an integrating sphere
Supply the lamp at [supply voltage in V]
steps: Start recording luminous flux at [sample rate in Hz] or faster
Switch the lamp on and note the switch-on time
Record the time at which luminous flux first reaches 400 lm
fields.expected_result: Luminous flux reaches at least 400 lm within 2.0 s of switch-on.
fields.pass_criterion: Luminous flux ≥ 400 lm, reached ≤ 2.0 s after switch-on

fields.inspect: Colour of the outer housing, under daylight, against [colour reference]

requirements.text: The housing shall carry a voltage label.

fields.inspect: The housing, for a label stating the voltage
fields.pass_condition: A voltage label is present on the housing.

note: The housing has one flat face; where to look is obvious.

source_anchor.quote: The switch shall be operable with one hand.

requirements.text: The switch shall be operable with one hand.

testability_flags.reason: 'operable with one hand' sets no force, reach or time limit.
testability_flags.suggested_rewrite: The switch shall be operable with one hand with a force of no more than [maximum force in N].

fields.description: An operator switches the lamp on and off using one hand only.
procedure: Hold the lamp in one hand, or mount it as installed
Operate the switch with the same hand, without using the other hand
fields.acceptance_criterion: The switch is operated with one hand with a force of no more than [maximum force in N].

note: No force limit until the spec gives one.

source_anchor.quote:
The lamp shall mount on either:

a. a 35 mm rail; or

b. a wall bracket.

requirements.text: The lamp shall mount on either a 35 mm rail or a wall bracket.

fields.inspect: The lamp's mounting interface, fitted to a 35 mm rail or to a wall bracket
fields.pass_condition: The lamp mounts on a 35 mm rail, or on a wall bracket.

note: The item should name the rail profile the 35 mm refers to.

source_anchor.quote: The bracket shall withstand a static load of 50 N without permanent deformation.

requirements.text: The bracket shall withstand a static load of 50 N without permanent deformation.

fields.description: Structural calculation of the bracket under a static load.
evidence: Stress calculation or FEA report showing peak stress below yield at 50 N
fields.acceptance_criterion: Peak stress at a 50 N static load is below the yield strength of [bracket material].
